title: Medtrum Nano Preferences: Hourly and Daily Maximum Insulin settings do not persisted on modfication
body:
**AndroidAPS 3.3.1.0-dev**
Build: f751b7658c
Flavor: fullrelease
Pump: Medtrum Nano

**Problem**
Pump driver Medtrum Preferences do not allow modifying the **Hourly and Daily Maximum Insulin settings**
User does get to option to change, modified value is not persisted however.


![Screenshot_20250113_182203_AAPS](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7a25655f-fe83-4819-a739-acfdfa6d5f40)

comments.body:
Logfile, UI test sequence:
1) Set logfile 'marker' event:
09:46:42.051: Export preferences (maintenance)

2) MT tab -> Metrum Preferences
3) Change Hourly -> 12, Change Daily Max -> 45
4) MT tab: refresh

Can not find anything in the log that could relate to the problem?

[AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18407960/AndroidAPS.log)

Confirming 👍 
With this preference changes  are persisted.
